verdict.rationale: Atlas handles signable legal documents: it creates, sends and tracks SAFEs and provides incorporation documents. Requiring stronger signer identity verification is therefore a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions SMS, ID-check or knowledge-based signer verification, or any configurable signer authentication requirement, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can require stronger signer identity verification (SMS, ID check, knowledge-based) on sensitive documents
